{{Quote|Our blockade is impenetrable. When the Republic attacks, they will get ''quite'' a surprise.|Mar Tuuk|audio=OurBlockadeIsImpenetrable-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
The '''Ryloth blockade''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] consisted of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] ''[[Procurer]]'' and six [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. It was blockading the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] under the command of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], and was mostly destroyed by the attack of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fleet during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. The remainders of the blockade were eventually routed by the forces of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
